quote: Great class, happy to enjoy their insights and share different points of view.
author: Deinia Betancourt Millet

quote: Very interesting, everything covered. Great class and great way of leading it. I hope to keep learning in this wonderful group and course. Thank you.

quote: For my part, very satisfied, exceeded my expectations. A pleasure to meet everyone and learn from each and every one of your experiences.
author: Edemny Violeta Hurtado Villaverde

quote: Yes! More courses like this please. Worth the effort and passion that both sides put into this wonderful 10-day journey. Blessings, I'm now a BENSO fan ❤️

quote: Good marketing in Cuba is possible, we just need to learn to work with what we have at hand and be creative. A quality, emotional encounter, pure protein for our minds. Grateful to Benso 🤗🫶🏽

quote: For me, most of the content was new, the teachers were excellent. What I do recommend is that this content be given in at least 2 or 3 classes, since for someone who doesn't know much about marketing it's a lot for one day.
author: Yeilis Hernández Díaz

quote: It has been super interesting, engaging and useful. In this course, with its teachers, I have met my expectations and more. I learned about theory and practical cases to achieve publications about entrepreneurship.
